/-!
# The literal upper coefficient of the compact extended-third policy

The initial rule uses the same old exponent and an actual dyadic first
label stop. At the third selected ancestor the policy reads the already
defined compact-cell level. All later decisions use that same ancestor.
An inactive ancestor restores the complete initial predicate exactly.

The physical coefficient is the existing actualSmallRoughRho applied to
this concrete policy. Its support, signed first-exit coefficient, small
attachment and majorant are identified without choosing a new coefficient
for a particular test integer. These finite identities do not identify its
full density with the harmonic profile or pay a counting remainder.
-/

/-- The complete inherited and third-cube Rosser tests, extracted locally
without the unrelated historical frontier imports. -/
private theorem actualExtendedThirdCompact_third_admissible_iff
    (Q : ℝ) (p1 p2 p3 : ℕ) (h3 : 0 < p3)
    (h32 : p3 < p2) (h21 : p2 < p1) :
    ordinaryRosserPrefixAdmissible false Q [p3, p2, p1] ↔
      (p1 : ℝ) ^ 3 < Q ∧ (p1 : ℝ) * p2 * p3 ^ 3 < Q := by
  have h31 := h32.trans h21
  let S : Finset ℕ := {p3, p2, p1}
  have hf1 : S.filter (fun p => p1 ≤ p) = {p1} := by
    ext p
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    omega
  have hf2 : S.filter (fun p => p2 ≤ p) = {p2, p1} := by
    ext p
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    omega
  have hf3 : S.filter (fun p => p3 ≤ p) = S := by
    ext p
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    omega
  have hc : UpperAdmissibleSet Q [p3, p2, p1].toFinset ↔
      (p1 : ℝ) ^ 3 < Q ∧ (p1 : ℝ) * p2 * p3 ^ 3 < Q := by
    simp only [List.toFinset_cons, List.toFinset_nil]
    change UpperAdmissibleSet Q S ↔ _
    simp only [UpperAdmissibleSet, S, Finset.forall_mem_insert,
      Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq]
    rw [hf1, hf2, hf3]
    norm_num [S, h32.ne, h21.ne, h31.ne, Nat.cast_mul, pow_succ,
      mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc, and_comm]
  have hsq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (p3 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hp3 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p3 := by exact_mod_cast h3
    nlinarith
  have hprod : (([p3, p2, p1].prod : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (p1 : ℝ) * p2 * p3 ^ 3 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq
      (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (p1 : ℝ) * p2 * p3)
    simp only [List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, Nat.cast_mul, mul_one]
    nlinarith only [hh]
  simp only [ordinaryRosserPrefixAdmissible, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, hc]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hprod.trans_lt h.2, h⟩⟩

/-- The first coordinate is owned half-open and its label's upper endpoint
passes the original closed first-stop wall. -/
def actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop (e : ℝ) (m N : ℕ) (history : List ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ i : Fin (2 ^ m),
    actualExtendedThirdDyadicLo m (fun _ => i) 0 ≤
        primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 1 history 0 ∧
      primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 1 history 0 <
        actualExtendedThirdDyadicHi m (fun _ => i) 0 ∧
      actualExtendedThirdDyadicHi m (fun _ => i) 0 ≤ thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e

def actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy (e : ℝ) (m N : ℕ) :
    Bool → List ℕ → Bool :=
  oddFirstExitPolicy fun history => decide
    (ordinaryRosserPrefixAdmissible false ((N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e)) history ∧
      (history.length = 1 → actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop e m N history))

def actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel (e h : ℝ) (m N : ℕ) (history : List ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (N : ℝ) ^ actualExtendedThirdCompactCellLevel e h m
    (primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 history)

def actualExtendedThirdCompactActive (e h : ℝ) (m N : ℕ) (history : List ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m,
    primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 history ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j

def actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy (e h : ℝ) (m N : ℕ) :
    Bool → List ℕ → Bool :=
  thirdCappedUpperPolicy (actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N)
    (actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel e h m N)

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel_on_cell {e h : ℝ} {m N : ℕ}
    {history : List ℕ} {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m}
    (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m)
    (ht : primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 history ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel e h m N history =
      (N : ℝ) ^ actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j := by
  unfold actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel
  rw [actualExtendedThirdCompactCellLevel_on_cell hj ht]

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel_inactive {e h : ℝ} {m N : ℕ}
    {history : List ℕ} (ha : ¬actualExtendedThirdCompactActive e h m N history) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel e h m N history =
      (N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e) := by
  unfold actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel
  rw [actualExtendedThirdCompactCellLevel_outside]
  intro j hj ht
  exact ha ⟨j, hj, ht⟩

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_through_two (e h : ℝ) (m N : ℕ)
    (positive : Bool) (history : List ℕ) (hlen : history.length ≤ 2) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N positive history =
      actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N positive history := by
  simp only [actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy, thirdCappedUpperPolicy,
    firstExitDepthSplicePolicy, if_pos hlen]

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_even (e h : ℝ) (m N : ℕ)
    (history : List ℕ) : actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N true history = true := by
  apply UpperPolicyFiniteBridge.thirdCappedUpperPolicy_even_retained
  intro pre

/-- Outside the adopted cells the full original first-stop predicate is
restored, rather than only its real exponent. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_inactive (e h : ℝ) (m N : ℕ)
    (positive : Bool) (history : List ℕ)
    (ha : ¬actualExtendedThirdCompactActive e h m N (rosserAncestor 3 history)) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N positive history =
      actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N positive history := by
  by_cases hlen : history.length ≤ 2
  · exact actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_through_two e h m N positive history hlen
  · have hne : history.length ≠ 1 := by omega
    simp [actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy, thirdCappedUpperPolicy,
      firstExitDepthSplicePolicy, hlen, frozenParityRosserPolicy, ancestorFrozenPolicy,
      actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel_inactive ha, ordinaryParityRosserPolicy,
      actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy, oddFirstExitPolicy, hne]

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_on_cell {e h : ℝ} {m N : ℕ}
    (positive : Bool) (history : List ℕ) (hlen : 3 ≤ history.length)
    {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m} (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m)
    (ht : primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 (rosserAncestor 3 history) ∈
      actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N positive history =
      ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false ((N : ℝ) ^ actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j)
        positive history := by
  have hdeep : ¬history.length ≤ 2 := by omega
  simp only [actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy, thirdCappedUpperPolicy,
    firstExitDepthSplicePolicy, if_neg hdeep, frozenParityRosserPolicy, ancestorFrozenPolicy]
  rw [actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel_on_cell hj ht]

/-- Later selections cannot change either the cell lookup or its level. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactFrozenLevel_append (e h : ℝ) (m N : ℕ)
    (later history : List ℕ) (hlen : 3 ≤ history.length) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel e h m N (rosserAncestor 3 (later ++ history)) =
      actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel e h m N (rosserAncestor 3 history) := by
  apply congrArg (actualExtendedThirdCompactRawLevel e h m N)
  unfold rosserAncestor
  rw [List.length_append, Nat.add_sub_assoc hlen, List.drop_length_add_append]

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_empty_cells (e h : ℝ) (m N : ℕ)
    (hempty : actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m = ∅) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N = actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N := by
  funext positive history
  apply actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_inactive
  rintro ⟨j, hj, _⟩
  rw [hempty] at hj
  exact Finset.notMem_empty j hj

/-- A genuinely adopted third-prime history already passes the same first
dyadic label stop; the first-stop test is not an extra action hypothesis. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop_of_cell {e h : ℝ} {m N : ℕ}
    (p0 p1 p2 : ℕ) {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m}
    (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m)
    (ht : primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 [p2, p1, p0] ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop e m N [p0] := by
  have hcoord : primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 1 [p0] 0 =
      primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 [p2, p1, p0] 0 := by
    simp [primeHistoryLogCoordinates, primeHistoryTuple]
  have hstop := (mem_actualExtendedThirdRetainedCells.mp
    (actualExtendedThirdCompactCells_subset e h m hj)).2
  refine ⟨j 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hcoord, actualExtendedThirdDyadicLo] using (ht.1 0 (mem_univ _)).1
  · simpa only [hcoord, actualExtendedThirdDyadicHi] using (ht.1 0 (mem_univ _)).2
  · simpa only [actualExtendedThirdDyadicHi] using hstop

/-- The initial singleton test retains its total-product condition as well
as its first cube and literal dyadic first stop. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy_first_iff (e : ℝ) (m N p : ℕ)
    (hp : 0 < p) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N false [p] = true ↔
      (p : ℝ) ^ 3 < (N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e) ∧
        actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop e m N [p] := by
  have hsq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp
    nlinarith
  have hprod : (p : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) p)
    simpa only [mul_one, pow_succ, mul_comm] using hm
  have hc : UpperAdmissibleSet ((N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e)) [p].toFinset ↔
      (p : ℝ) ^ 3 < (N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e) := by
    simp [UpperAdmissibleSet, Finset.filter_singleton, pow_succ, mul_comm]
  change decide (ordinaryRosserPrefixAdmissible false
    ((N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e)) [p] ∧
      (([p] : List ℕ).length = 1 → actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop e m N [p])) = true ↔ _
  rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
  simp only [ordinaryRosserPrefixAdmissible, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false,
    List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one, hc]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1.2, h.2 rfl⟩,
    fun h => ⟨⟨hprod.trans_lt h.1, h.1⟩, fun _ => h.2⟩⟩

/-- Positivity of only the selected first prime suffices to read its cube
from the actual cell's logarithmic coordinates. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactCell_prime_firstCube {e h : ℝ} {m N : ℕ}
    (hN : 1 < N) (he0 : 0 < e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 384)
    (hmesh : actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m ≤ e / 2)
    (p0 p1 p2 : ℕ) (hp0 : 0 < p0) {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m}
    (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m)
    (ht : primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 [p2, p1, p0] ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j) :
    (p0 : ℝ) ^ 3 < (N : ℝ) ^ actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j := by
  have hNr : (1 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hpow : (N : ℝ) ^ (primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 [p2, p1, p0] 0) = (p0 : ℝ) := by
    simpa [primeHistoryLogCoordinates, primeHistoryTuple, actualPrimeTupleLog] using
      actualPrimeTupleLog_rpow hN (fun _ : Fin 1 => p0) (fun _ => hp0) 0
  exact actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel_prime_firstCube p0 hNr he0 he hmesh
    (actualExtendedThirdCompactCells_subset e h m hj)
    (actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell_subset_physicalCell m j ht) hpow.symm.le

/-- Every genuinely adopted triple has already passed the initial first
selection. This obligation is proved from the same cap and same owned cell. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy_first_of_cell {e h : ℝ} {m N : ℕ}
    (hN : 1 < N) (he0 : 0 < e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 384)
    (hmesh : actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m ≤ e / 2)
    (p0 p1 p2 : ℕ) (hp0 : 0 < p0) {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m}
    (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m)
    (ht : primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 [p2, p1, p0] ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N false [p0] = true := by
  have hNr : (1 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  apply (actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy_first_iff e m N p0 hp0).mpr
  refine ⟨?_, actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop_of_cell p0 p1 p2 hj ht⟩
  exact (actualExtendedThirdCompactCell_prime_firstCube hN he0 he hmesh p0 p1 p2 hp0 hj ht).trans_le
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hNr.le
      (thirdPrefixBufferedCap_le_root e (actualExtendedThirdPhysicalGamma e m j)))

/-- The actual cap's already proved first-cube margin pays that inherited
test at the third admission, even though the new level may be smaller. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_third_iff {e h : ℝ} {m N : ℕ}
    (hN : 1 < N) (he0 : 0 < e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 384)
    (hmesh : actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m ≤ e / 2)
    (p0 p1 p2 : ℕ) (hp2 : 0 < p2) (hp21 : p2 < p1) (hp10 : p1 < p0)
    {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m} (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m)
    (ht : primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 [p2, p1, p0] ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N false [p2, p1, p0] = true ↔
      (p0 : ℝ) * p1 * p2 ^ 3 < (N : ℝ) ^ actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j := by
  have hfirst := actualExtendedThirdCompactCell_prime_firstCube hN he0 he hmesh
    p0 p1 p2 (by omega) hj ht
  have hself : rosserAncestor 3 [p2, p1, p0] = [p2, p1, p0] := by simp [rosserAncestor]
  have hpolicy := actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_on_cell false [p2, p1, p0]
    (by simp) hj (by simpa only [hself] using ht)
  rw [hpolicy]
  change decide (ordinaryRosserPrefixAdmissible false
    ((N : ℝ) ^ actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j) [p2, p1, p0]) = true ↔ _
  rw [decide_eq_true_eq, actualExtendedThirdCompact_third_admissible_iff _ p0 p1 p2 hp2 hp21 hp10]
  exact and_iff_right hfirst

/-- The support and coefficient use the existing physical construction,
with one retention predicate fixed before a test integer is supplied. -/
def actualExtendedThirdCompactModuli (e h : ℝ) (m N cap : ℕ) (w z : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  actualSmallRoughModuli (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N false) N cap w z

def actualExtendedThirdCompactRho (e h : ℝ) (m N cap : ℕ) (w z L : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  actualSmallRoughRho (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N false) N cap w z L

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactRho_eq_firstExitAttachment
    (e h : ℝ) (m N cap : ℕ) (w z L : ℝ) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactRho e h m N cap w z L =
      smallRoughRho (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w)
        (firstExitRetainedModuli (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N)
          (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z))
        (fun d => (firstExitRetainedCoefficient (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N)
          (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z) d : ℝ))
        (actualSmallRosserMinus N cap w L) (actualSmallRosserPlus N cap w L) := by
  exact UpperPolicyFiniteBridge.actualSmallRoughRho_eq_firstExitAttachment
    (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N)
    (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_even e h m N) N cap w z L

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactRoughDensity_eq_policy
    (e h : ℝ) (m N cap : ℕ) (w z : ℝ) :
    reciprocalTotientDensity
        (fixedRoughSupport (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N false) N cap w z)
        (fixedRoughCoefficient (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N false) N cap w z) =
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N)
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z) := by
  exact (UpperPolicyFiniteBridge.firstExitRetainedPolynomial_eq_fixedRoughDensity_of_even_retained
    (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N)
    (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_even e h m N) N cap w z).symm

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactRho_majorant (e h : ℝ) (m N cap : ℕ) (w z L : ℝ)
    (hL : 1 < L) (hwL : w ≤ L) (hwz : w ≤ z) (hzcap : z ≤ (cap : ℝ)) (n : ℤ) :
    actualSmallRoughIndicator N z n ≤
      physicalDivisorSum (actualExtendedThirdCompactModuli e h m N cap w z)
        (actualExtendedThirdCompactRho e h m N cap w z L) n.natAbs := by
  exact actualSmallRoughRho_majorant _ N cap w z L hL hwL hwz hzcap n

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactRho_abs_le_one (e h : ℝ) (m N cap : ℕ)
    (w z L : ℝ) (q : ℕ) : |actualExtendedThirdCompactRho e h m N cap w z L q| ≤ 1 := by
  exact actualSmallRoughRho_abs_le_one _ N cap w z L q

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactModuli_squarefree (e h : ℝ) (m N cap : ℕ)
    (w z : ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactModuli e h m N cap w z) :
    Squarefree q := by
  exact actualSmallRoughModuli_squarefree _ N cap w z hq

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactModuli_coprime_target (e h : ℝ) (m N cap : ℕ)
    (w z : ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactModuli e h m N cap w z) :
    q.Coprime N := by
  exact actualSmallRoughModuli_coprime_target _ N cap w z hq

/-- An empty adopted table restores precisely the original initial-policy
coefficient on every modulus, not merely its total density. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactRho_empty_cells (e h : ℝ) (m N cap : ℕ) (w z L : ℝ)
    (hempty : actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m = ∅) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactRho e h m N cap w z L =
      actualSmallRoughRho (actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N false) N cap w z L := by
  unfold actualExtendedThirdCompactRho
  rw [actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_empty_cells e h m N hempty]

import ImbalancedChen.ActualExtendedThirdCompactUpperRho

/-!
# The initial dyadic first stop is an exact prime cutoff

The union of the actual owned first-coordinate bins is the half-open
interval ending at step times floor((rho-4e)/step). This exponent can be
zero on a coarse grid. The corresponding strict prime cutoff is retained
literally, including equality at an endpoint.

Splitting the original decreasing prime universe at that cutoff removes
only a high segment whose first selections all fail. The low segment has
the same ordinary full tests: after the first selection, the extra initial
first-stop implication is vacuous. The root is therefore the actual
ordinary plus density on this precise truncated carrier, at its unchanged
old level. No density estimate or comparison by nonnegativity is assumed.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

open Set
open scoped Classical

def actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent (e : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m *
    (⌊(thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e) / actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m⌋₊ : ℝ)

theorem actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent_bounds {e : ℝ}
    (he0 : 0 < e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 384) (m : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent e m ∧
      actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent e m ≤ thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e ∧
        thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e - actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m <
          actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent e m ∧
            actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent e m < thirdPrefixRho := by
  have hd := actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep_pos m
  have hw : 0 ≤ thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e := by
    dsimp [thirdPrefixRho]
    linarith
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ (thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e) / actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m :=
    div_nonneg hw hd.le
  have hcancel : actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m *
      ((thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e) / actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m) = thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e := by
    simpa only [mul_comm] using div_mul_cancel₀ (thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e) hd.ne'
  have hupper : actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent e m ≤ thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e := by
    unfold actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Nat.floor_le hdiv) hd.le).trans_eq hcancel
  have hnext := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left
    (Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e) / actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m)) hd
  rw [hcancel] at hnext
  refine ⟨mul_nonneg hd.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _), hupper, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent
    nlinarith only [hnext]
  · exact hupper.trans_lt (by linarith)

private theorem initialDyadicLo_step (m : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ m)) :
    actualExtendedThirdDyadicLo m (fun _ => i) 0 =
      actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m * (i.val : ℝ) := by
  unfold actualExtendedThirdDyadicLo actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep
  ring

private theorem initialDyadicHi_step (m : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ m)) :
    actualExtendedThirdDyadicHi m (fun _ => i) 0 =
      actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m * ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  unfold actualExtendedThirdDyadicHi actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep
  ring

private theorem initialDyadicStep_full (m : ℕ) :
    actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m * ((2 ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) = thirdPrefixRho := by
  simp only [actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)

private theorem compactFirstStop_iff_log {e : ℝ} (he0 : 0 < e)
    (he : e ≤ 1 / 384) (m N : ℕ) (history : List ℕ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 1 history 0) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop e m N history ↔
      primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 1 history 0 <
        actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent e m := by
  let d := actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m
  let wall := thirdPrefixRho - 4 * e
  let x := primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 1 history 0
  let k := ⌊wall / d⌋₊
  have hd : 0 < d := actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep_pos m
  have hw : 0 ≤ wall := by
    dsimp [wall, thirdPrefixRho]
    linarith
  have hwdiv : 0 ≤ wall / d := div_nonneg hw hd.le
  have hxd : 0 ≤ x / d := div_nonneg hx hd.le
  have hkn : k < 2 ^ m := by
    apply (Nat.floor_lt hwdiv).mpr
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hd).mpr
    calc
      wall < thirdPrefixRho := by dsimp [wall]; linarith
      _ = ((2 ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * d := by
        simpa only [mul_comm] using (initialDyadicStep_full m).symm
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, _hlo, hhi, hwall⟩
    rw [initialDyadicHi_step] at hhi hwall
    have hik : i.val + 1 ≤ k := (Nat.le_floor_iff hwdiv).mpr
      ((le_div_iff₀ hd).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hwall))
    change x < d * (k : ℝ)
    exact hhi.trans_le (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast hik) hd.le)
  · intro hcut
    change x < d * (k : ℝ) at hcut
    let a := ⌊x / d⌋₊
    have hak : a < k := (Nat.floor_lt hxd).mpr
      ((div_lt_iff₀ hd).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hcut))
    let i : Fin (2 ^ m) := ⟨a, hak.trans hkn⟩
    refine ⟨i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [initialDyadicLo_step]
      simpa only [i, mul_comm] using (le_div_iff₀ hd).mp (Nat.floor_le hxd)
    · rw [initialDyadicHi_step]
      have hnext := (div_lt_iff₀ hd).mp (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (x / d))
      simpa only [i, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, mul_comm] using hnext
    · rw [initialDyadicHi_step]
      have ha : a + 1 ≤ k := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hak
      have hbound : d * ((a + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ d * (k : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast ha) hd.le
      exact hbound.trans (actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent_bounds he0 he m).2.1

/-- This is the original strict prime endpoint, including a zero stop
exponent on coarse grids. No first-cube test is discarded. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop_iff_prime {e : ℝ}
    (he0 : 0 < e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 384) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 < N)
    (m p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop e m N [p] ↔
      (p : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) ^ actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent e m := by
  have hNr : (1 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ p by omega)
  have hx : 0 ≤ primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 1 [p] 0 := by
    simpa [primeHistoryLogCoordinates, primeHistoryTuple] using
      div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hp1) (Real.log_pos hNr).le
  have hpow : (N : ℝ) ^ primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 1 [p] 0 = (p : ℝ) := by
    simpa [primeHistoryLogCoordinates, primeHistoryTuple, actualPrimeTupleLog] using
      actualPrimeTupleLog_rpow hN (fun _ : Fin 1 => p) (fun _ => hp) 0
  rw [compactFirstStop_iff_log he0 he m N [p] hx,
    ← Real.rpow_lt_rpow_left_iff hNr, hpow]

/-- The original target N itself covers the precise first-stop cutoff. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdInitialStop_cutoff_le_target {e : ℝ}
    (he0 : 0 < e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 384) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 < N) (m : ℕ) :
    (N : ℝ) ^ actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent e m ≤ (N : ℝ) := by
  have hNr : (1 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  calc
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hNr.le
      ((actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent_bounds he0 he m).2.2.2.le.trans
        (by norm_num [thirdPrefixRho]))
    _ = _ := Real.rpow_one _

private theorem initial_next_eq_ordinary (e : ℝ) (m N : ℕ)
    (positive : Bool) (q : ℕ) (history : List ℕ) (hne : history ≠ []) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N positive (q :: history) =
      ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false ((N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e))
        positive (q :: history) := by
  have hlen : (q :: history).length ≠ 1 := by
    intro hh
    apply hne
    apply List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp
    simp only [List.length_cons] at hh
    omega
  simp [actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy, ordinaryParityRosserPolicy,
    oddFirstExitPolicy, hlen]

private theorem initial_nonempty_continuation (e : ℝ) (m N : ℕ)
    (weight : ℕ → ℝ) (remaining history : List ℕ) (positive : Bool) (mass : ℝ)
    (hne : history ≠ []) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N)
        weight history positive mass remaining =
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial
        (ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false ((N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e)))
        weight history positive mass remaining := by
  induction remaining generalizing history positive mass with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons q qs ih =>
      simp only [firstExitRetainedPolynomial,
        initial_next_eq_ordinary e m N (!positive) q history hne]
      rw [ih history positive mass hne]
      by_cases hq : ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false ((N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e))
          (!positive) (q :: history) = true
      · rw [if_pos hq, if_pos hq, ih (q :: history) (!positive) (mass * weight q) (by simp)]
      · rw [if_neg hq, if_neg hq]

private theorem initial_root_on_low (e : ℝ) (m N : ℕ) (weight : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ)
    (hstop : ∀ p ∈ carrier, actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop e m N [p]) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N)
        weight [] true 1 carrier =
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial
        (ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false ((N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e)))
        weight [] true 1 carrier := by
  revert hstop
  induction carrier with
  | nil => intro _; rfl
  | cons p ps ih =>
      intro hstop
      have hp := hstop p (by simp)
      have hps := fun q hq => hstop q (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq)
      have htest : actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N false [p] =
          ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false ((N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e)) false [p] := by
        simp [actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy, ordinaryParityRosserPolicy,
          oddFirstExitPolicy, hp]
      simp only [firstExitRetainedPolynomial, htest]
      rw [ih hps]
      by_cases ht : ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false ((N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e))
          false [p] = true
      · rw [if_pos ht, if_pos ht,
          initial_nonempty_continuation e m N weight ps [p] false (1 * weight p) (by simp)]
      · rw [if_neg ht, if_neg ht]

private theorem initial_root_skip_high (e : ℝ) (m N : ℕ) (weight : ℕ → ℝ)
    (high low : List ℕ)
    (hfail : ∀ p ∈ high, actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N false [p] = false) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N)
        weight [] true 1 (high ++ low) =
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial (actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N)
        weight [] true 1 low := by
  revert hfail
  induction high with
  | nil => intro _; rfl
  | cons p ps ih =>
      intro hfail
      have hp := hfail p (by simp)
      simpa only [List.cons_append, firstExitRetainedPolynomial, hp,
        Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, add_zero] using
        ih (fun q hq => hfail q (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq))

/-- The same initial policy has exactly the ordinary plus density at its
true dyadic cutoff. The original cap is N and the full polynomial has w=0.
The old level retains both total-product and every inherited cubic test. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdInitialPolicy_eq_actualPlus {e : ℝ}
    (he0 : 0 < e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 384) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 < N) (m : ℕ) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N)
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1
        (roughPrimeUniverse N N 0 ((N : ℝ) ^ thirdPrefixRho)) =
      actualSmallRosserPlusDensity N N
        ((N : ℝ) ^ actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent e m)
        ((N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e)) := by
  let z := (N : ℝ) ^ actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent e m
  let weight := fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)
  have hNr : (1 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hz : z ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ thirdPrefixRho :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hNr.le
      (actualExtendedThirdInitialStopExponent_bounds he0 he m).2.2.2.le
  have hfail : ∀ p ∈ roughPrimeUniverse N N z ((N : ℝ) ^ thirdPrefixRho),
      actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N false [p] = false := by
    intro p hp
    have hn : ¬actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop e m N [p] := by
      intro hs
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (mem_roughPrimeUniverse_lower hp))
        ((actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop_iff_prime he0 he hN m p
          (mem_roughPrimeUniverse_prime hp).pos).mp hs)
    simp [actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy, oddFirstExitPolicy, hn]
  have hstop : ∀ p ∈ roughPrimeUniverse N N 0 z,
      actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop e m N [p] := by
    intro p hp
    exact (actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop_iff_prime he0 he hN m p
      (mem_roughPrimeUniverse_prime hp).pos).mpr (mem_roughPrimeUniverse_upper hp)
  rw [roughPrimeUniverse_split N N z ((N : ℝ) ^ thirdPrefixRho) hz,
    initial_root_skip_high e m N weight _ _ hfail,
    initial_root_on_low e m N weight _ hstop]
  have hlevel : 0 < thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e := by
    dsimp [thirdPrefixTheta]
    linarith
  simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] using
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial_ordinaryParityRosser_eq_actualDensity
      false N N z ((N : ℝ) ^ (thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e))
      (Real.one_lt_rpow hNr hlevel) (by simp)

/-!
# The literal compact policy's third-candidate prime carrier

The actual rank-two first-exit frontier supplies the third candidate
before its own cube is tested. On an adopted cell its initial first-prime
admission is proved from the same physical cap. The filtered frontier is
exactly the existing strictly ordered prime-cell carrier, retaining the
original rough enumeration cap and target-prime exclusions.

An arbitrary signed test on the actual original candidates therefore has
the same tuple sum, and then the same product-image sum with weight
1/phi(n). No Cartesian replacement, factorial, first-exit density identity
or arithmetic counting remainder is asserted here.
-/

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactOwnedCell_primeRegion {e h : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m}
    (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m) {t : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j) :
    t ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j := by
  have hz : 0 < t 2 := hh.trans_le ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.trans
    (ht.1 2 (mem_univ _)).1)
  have hxrho : t 0 ≤ thirdPrefixRho :=
    (ht.1 0 (mem_univ _)).2.le.trans (actualExtendedThirdDyadic_bounds m j 0).2.2
  exact ⟨ht, hz, (ht.2.2.1.trans ht.2.2.2).trans hxrho, ht.2.2.1, ht.2.2.2, hxrho⟩

/-- The retained cutoff gives an actual lower prime bound. The original
right cutoff is rho, even though the analytic bounding cube is larger. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactOwnedCell_log_bounds {e h : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m}
    (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m) {t : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j) (i : Fin 3) :
    h ≤ t i ∧ t i < thirdPrefixRho := by
  have hz : h ≤ t 2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.trans (ht.1 2 (mem_univ _)).1
  have hlo : h ≤ t i := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact (hz.trans ht.2.2.1).trans ht.2.2.2
    · exact hz.trans ht.2.2.1
    · exact hz
  exact ⟨hlo, (ht.1 i (mem_univ _)).2.trans_le
    (actualExtendedThirdDyadic_bounds m j i).2.2⟩

    primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 [p 2, p 1, p 0] = actualPrimeTupleLog N p := by

  change (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N false [p 0] = true ∧

  rw [actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_through_two e h m N false [p 0] (by simp),
    actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_even]

No caller-supplied prefix-admissibility premise remains on the cell. -/

    (hmesh : actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m ≤ e / 2)

    (hmesh : actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m ≤ e / 2) (w : ℝ)
    (hw : w ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ h) (hcap : (N : ℝ) ^ thirdPrefixRho ≤ (cap : ℝ))
    {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m} (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m) :
    (firstExitFrontierTuples 2 (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N)
        (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w ((N : ℝ) ^ thirdPrefixRho))).filter
        (fun p => actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j) =
      actualExtendedThirdDistinctCellPrimeTuples N h m j := by

  ext p
  rw [Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, ht⟩
    obtain ⟨hs, hp, _hv⟩ := (mem_actualPrimeFrontierTuples_iff_of_cutoff_le_cap
      2 (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N) N cap w _ hcap p).mp hf
    have hregion := actualExtendedThirdCompactOwnedCell_primeRegion hh hj ht
    have hbox : p ∈ actualPrimeBoxTuples N (fun _ : Fin 3 => h / 2)
        (fun _ => thirdPrefixRho + 1) :=

        ⟨fun i => ⟨(hp i).1, (hp i).2.1⟩,

    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr

    intro i

    · change actualPrimeTupleLog N p 2 - actualPrimeTupleLog N p 1 < 0
      linarith only [hslog (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) < 2)]
  · intro hp

    have ht := hpregion.1.1
    obtain ⟨h10, h21⟩ := actualExtendedThirdDistinctCellPrimeRegion_prime_order hN hpbox hpregion
    have hs : StrictAnti p := by

    (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w ((N : ℝ) ^ thirdPrefixRho))).map (fun candidate =>

            actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j then

  unfold actualExtendedThirdCompactFrontierCellSum
  change ((firstExitFrontierCandidates 2 (actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N)
    (fun q : ℕ => 1 / ((q : ℝ) - 1))
    (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w ((N : ℝ) ^ thirdPrefixRho))).map (fun candidate =>

        (if actualPrimeTupleLog N (primeHistoryTuple 3 candidate.selectedPrefix) ∈
            actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j then

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactFrontierCellSum_eq_product_sum {e h : ℝ} {m N cap : ℕ}

The gate is the literal integer-prefix product times the last prime squared.
It is identified exactly with a strict affine logarithmic inequality. The
normalized density is the actual lower Rosser density at the quotient level.
Its compact uniform approximation is proved even up to the closed legal
boundary. A continuous extension of the limiting profile is used outside
the gate; this extension is never substituted for an illegal residual.

/-- The own-cube logarithmic form, on a nonempty tuple. -/
def primeTupleOwnCubeForm {k : ℕ} (t : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ) : ℝ :=

/-- Continuous extension of the legal normalized lower residual profile. -/
def primeTupleMinusProfile {k : ℕ} (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ) : ℝ :=

    suzukiContinuousLowerFactor (max 2 ((lambda - ∑ i, t i) / t (Fin.last k)))

    actualSmallRosserMinusDensity N cap (p (Fin.last k) : ℝ)

  have hsum : Continuous (fun t : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ => ∑ i, t i) := by fun_prop

      max 2 ((lambda - ∑ i, t i) / t (Fin.last k)))
      (Set.univ.pi (fun _ => Set.Icc a b)) :=

      hlast.continuousOn hne)

    (continuousOn_suzukiContinuousLowerFactor.comp harg
      (fun t _ => le_max_left (2 : ℝ) ((lambda - ∑ i, t i) / t (Fin.last k))))

    {t : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ} (ht : 0 < t (Fin.last k))

  have hP : (0 : ℝ) < (∏ i, p i : ℕ) := by

    exact residual_rpow_log_div _ _ hNr hP

      mul_comm (2 : ℝ), Real.rpow_mul (by positivity),
      actualPrimeTupleLog_rpow hN p hp, Real.rpow_two]

  have hC : IsCompact C := (isCompact_univ_pi (fun _ => isCompact_Icc)).inter_right

      actualPrimeBoxTestSum N (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => a) (fun _ => b)
        (fun t => if t ∈ R then

    if actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ R then
